description:

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

 

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

Your Qualifications

  • Detail-oriented, structured, and proactive in taking ownership of tasks.

  • Fluency in German (minimum C1) and English.

  • Comfortable working with tools such as Google Workspace or Microsoft Office; any experience with HRIS or reporting tools is a bonus.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

 

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible.
 

Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep.
That's your world.
As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.
 
Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
  • Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems -  this is your core strength
  • Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
  • Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
  • Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
  • Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
  • Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
  • Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
  • Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
  • Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer: 

  • great freedom for your creative ideas.
  • ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment.
  • Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design.
  • support with your relocation
  • a comprehensive induction with your colleagues by your side.
  • 30-day vacation by default.
  • an extra day off to get involved in social activities as part of our Volunteer Day.
  • attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program.
  • unforgettable moments at our company events and team events.


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by phone +49 89 2441067714.

title: Responsable Comptable Process & outils - CDI (H/F/X)
description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Nous recherchons un Responsable Comptable Process & Outils passionné, prêt à transformer nos opérations comptables au sein de notre équipe. Ce rôle stratégique combine une expertise comptable pointue avec des compétences en gestion de projet et en leadership, afin de piloter l'optimisation et la fiabilisation de nos processus et outils, notamment sur les périmètres de la comptabilité fournisseurs (BP et IP) et des stocks.


🎯 MISSIONS

En tant que pilier de l'amélioration continue, vous serez au cœur de l'évolution de nos pratiques comptables. Vos responsabilités principales incluront :

Activité 1 : Pilotage de Projets Process & Outils

  • Concevoir et déployer une feuille de route ambitieuse pour les projets d'optimisation, en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Tech. ; que ce soit dans le développement de nos outils, comme dans  l’intégration de l’IA dans nos process

  • Analyser les besoins, définir les processus cibles et mener l'automatisation des flux pour une efficacité maximale.

  • Diriger en autonomie les projets d'évolution et de développement de nos outils comptables, en alignement avec les objectifs de la Direction Financière.

    • Activité 2 :Optimisation et Fiabilisation des Processus Comptables 

  • Identifier et analyser les pistes d'amélioration, en proposant des solutions innovantes (IA ou développement d’outils)

  • Garantir la bonne application des process et booster la performance des équipes grâce à des flux optimisés.

  • Mettre en place des outils ou solutions garantissant l'application rigoureuse des procédures et schémas comptables en vigueur dans le département.

  • Être le référent clé pour les audits internes et externes, garantissant une conformité irréprochable.

    • Activité 3:  Management et développement de l’équipe 

  • Manager, animer et faire grandir une équipe dédiée à l'accompagnement du changement, à la formation et au support fonctionnel.

  • Développer les compétences de vos collaborateurs à travers la formation et une montée en puissance structurée.

  • Mettre en place et suivre des reportings et des KPI comptables pertinents pour une visibilité complète de l'activité.

    • Activité 4 : Support, Conformité et Qualité

  • Mettre à jour et diffuser les modes opératoires et supports, assurant une base de connaissances à jour.

  • Assurer la formation et le support quotidien des équipes (présentiel et à distance) pour une autonomie renforcée.

  • Formaliser et implémenter des contrôles opérationnels (RIB, PO, etc.) et les schémas comptables.

  • Définir et superviser les actions correctives nécessaires suite aux contrôles ou audits.


    • 👉 PRÉ REQUIS

    Formation & Expérience :

  • Diplôme supérieur en Comptabilité (BAC+2 minimum), socle indispensable de votre expertise.
  • Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en comptabilité, dont une première expérience managériale où vous avez déjà démontré votre capacité à encadrer et inspirer.
  • Une expérience confirmée en gestion de projet sera un atout majeur pour mener nos initiatives d'optimisation.

  • Maîtrise indispensable des principes et techniques comptables.
  • Forte appétence pour les outils informatiques et les ERP comptables ; la connaissance de SAP est un atout majeur.
  • Une première expérience avec l'Intelligence Artificielle (IA) serait un plus, témoignant de votre curiosité pour l'innovation.
  • Anglais courant indispensable pour échanger dans notre contexte international.
